Standing by under shelter to show presence before resuming routes, remaining vigilant for response calls and incidents.
Leaving standby and continuing Delta Route.
Check-in at corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane, all clear.
Welfare check at Hoka, UGG Shoes, Haven Mart, North Face, Taco Bell, Shortland Street Convenience Store, all clear.

Check-in at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Check-in at Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear.

Response message from Edward and Ahmid regarding a suspicious male scoping out the stores while sitting on a scooter in front of Faradays; at the same time, a response call from Acceco Supermarket regarding a male individual who damaged their front wall, with assistance requested to deal with him. As the Acceco individual had an object in his hand that he used to scrape the wall and the team cannot split, attending the Acceco Supermarket call first.

Tracked the Acceco individual using the description from staff and caught up with him in front of Sale Shop. Asked why he damaged the property; he refused to give a reason. Issued him a verbal trespass, after which he turned and left. Notified Acceco staff, reassured them of their safety, and advised them to call us straight away if he shows his face again.
Response call from NZ Community Patrol regarding a male individual smoking in front of ANZ; assistance requested to deal with him.
Arrived at the response call and asked the male individual to stop smoking illegal cannabis in public; he complied, got up and left.

Attended the earlier response message regarding the suspicious individual in front of Faradays; he had left. Notified Ahmid, who advised to keep an eye out for the individual in case we encounter him again.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived outside Cotton On; welfare check on stores within the area.
Welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues reported from any of the stores. Standing by to provide security presence for the surrounding businesses in case assistance is needed.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area and no response calls received.
Arrived outside Novo Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by to provide security presence for surrounding businesses.
Departing standby area; no issues reported and no response calls during the time.

Arrived at the bottom of Vulcan Lane. A male person of interest flagged by the Morning Shift was sighted standing at the bottom of Vulcan Lane eyeing out the stores. Standing by in case the POI makes a move on any of the surrounding businesses, while remaining available for response calls.
Arrived at Jean Batten Place; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at Fort Street check-in; welfare check on stores within the area and commencing a full sweep down to Gore Street.
Arrived at Gore Street; welfare check on stores along Fort Street, Commerce Street and Gore Street, all clear — none of the stores had anything to report.

Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for security presence, ensuring visibility to members of the public and keeping a lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Departing standby area, no issues spotted; heading back up Queen Street.
Maintaining presence on Queen Street while taking cover due to bad weather conditions.
Response call from Unichem Queen Street regarding vagrants smoking cannabis outside their store; assistance requested to move them along.
Response call from 77 Convenience Store Victoria Street West regarding a male vagrant consuming cannabis outside their store; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at Unichem Queen Street; informed the vagrants they needed to move along, and they complied.

Arrived at 77 Convenience Store at the top of Victoria Street West; informed the male vagrant consuming cannabis outside the store that he had to move along. He was compliant; standing by while he gathered his belongings.
Male vagrant has moved along successfully.
Standing by at the top of Victoria Street West for security presence for surrounding businesses while taking cover from the bad weather.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in; standing by for security presence while taking cover due to bad weather conditions.
Leaving standby area, no issues occurred; heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone (percentage displayed on the kitchen camera).
Response call from The Fox at the Viaduct regarding a male causing a disturbance inside their bar and scaring staff members; assistance requested to remove him.
Arrived at The Fox; the male had already departed the premises. Standing by in case he returns. (Photo on file.)
Departing the Viaduct; no visual of the POI.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Fort Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at High Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square check-in, all clear, no issues; heading back to HQ.
Response call from Danny Doolans requesting assistance to remove the same male POI from earlier in the evening.
Arrived at Danny Doolans; informed the male he had to depart the premises. He was compliant; standing by.
Male successfully removed from the premises; heading back to HQ for handover.
Arrived at HQ; awaiting the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief completed; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Charging of the Ops Phone completed; commencing floor checks.
Toilet break and gearing up completed; commencing patrols.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; patrolling down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street, no issues to report; patrolling through Britomart.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Quay Street.
Quay Street all clear; sighted a fellow guard standing by at the bottom of Lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues to report; patrolling up Albert Street.
Standing down from patrols — response call received from McDonald's Britomart regarding a commotion happening inside the premises; en route to the location.
Arrived at the location; Police were on the scene and both parties walked inside to remove the two individuals. No issues; standing by outside for any further disturbances.
Standing down, no further assistance needed. Welfare check at McDonald's, all clear, no issues; patrolling to Gore Street.
Customs Street all clear, no issues; patrolling down Gore Street.
Arrived at Harbour Suites; maintaining presence (01:22–03:09).
Welfare check at Harbour Suites, all clear, no issues to report; patrolling down Fort Street.
Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare check at Tribe Hotel, Jo & Joes, The White Lady and Wilson Fort Carpark, all clear, no issues to report; patrolling up to High Street.
Shortland Street all clear, no issues; patrolling up High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues; continuing up High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep of the area (03:23–03:45).
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, Chancery Street and O'Connell Street, no issues confirmed; continuing up High Street.
Full sweep of the whole of High Street, no issues confirmed; patrolling up Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Lorne staircase centre and Red Radisson, all clear, no issues.
Whole of Lorne Street all clear, no issues to report; patrolling down Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues; patrolling through Albert Street.
Top half of Albert Street covered; welfare check at Skymart Convenience Store, all clear. Arrived at Federal Square, commencing sweep of the area (04:35–04:50).
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare check at Liston House, Indigo Hotel and the Cathedral, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Albert Street.
Swanson Street West all clear, no issues; patrolling down Albert Street.
Bottom half of Albert Street all clear; welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Lower Albert Street.
Full sweep of Lower Albert Street, no issues; arriving at Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; maintaining presence while commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's and staff, all clear, no issues; heading back to Headquarters.
Break completed; awaiting guard handover in the office while remaining available for any calls.
Night Shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.
